security_problem: mcp-visor --client-id and --session-id are operator-supplied strings. If visor-session accepts extra visor flags that set those values, or starts visor from a mapping that did not come from visor-gateway, a caller can spoof visor identity policy. A cleartext non-loopback gateway URL or an oversized JSON body can substitute that mapping.
required_behavior: visor-session POSTs the access token to visor-gateway with a DPoP proof. The gateway URL must be https except loopback http, with no query or fragment. HTTP redirects are not followed. The response body is capped at 1MiB. Only a complete visoradapter mapping from that response is passed as mcp-visor serve -client-id and -session-id. Extra visor arguments cannot set -client-id, --client-id, -session-id, or --session-id, including = forms. -dpop-key must be a 0600 Ed25519 key file. -print prints argv and does not exec. Hand-starting visor with a typed --client-id remains spoofable; this command is the supported authentic path. This is not Production.
failure_behavior: Fail closed: missing token or DPoP key, disallowed gateway URL, HTTP redirects, non-200 or incomplete mapping, oversized body, world-readable dpop-key, and extra identity flags produce a process or CLI error and do not exec visor with caller-supplied identity.
